items.title: Third consecutive same-completed-bar window (pre-market -> morning -> pre-close) holds Tier-A coverage and persistence FLAT while the off-hours legs OSCILLATE BIDIRECTIONALLY around a frozen 07-31 bar: this pre-close snapshot (asOf 2026-08-02T18:30:23.277Z) again advances the intraday window without advancing the completed-bar frontier (still 2026-07-31, 287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), so richCount/coverageCount hold 12/10, no headless adapter re-flips, and no persistence counter increments - but unlike the prior window (where the lone crypto leg only EASED), this window shows the BTC-USD leg REVERSE and firm (30.9 -> 31.3) while the global-rotation board also firms (EWS 83.5 -> 83.7, EWA 64.7 -> 66.4, EWC 66.1 -> 66.3)
items.note: Genuinely new vs the prior 'intra-bar window progression' pattern (which observed a single monotonically-easing crypto leg). Two new facts distinguish this run: (1) DIRECTION REVERSAL OF THE LONE MOVER: the BTC-USD daily-dated leg has now traced 31.4 -> 31.1 -> 30.9 -> 31.3 across four successive same-07-31-bar windows, i.e. it eased for three windows then FIRMED this window while holding its unchanged 2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z stamp and Downtrend classification (mom21 -0.85, mom63 -14.08, mom126 -4.15). Off-hours re-quotes therefore WANDER BOTH DIRECTIONS around a frozen completed bar - they are noise, not a trend, and must never move persistence. (2) A SECOND LEG DRIFTS: the global-rotation board firmed modestly this window on its unchanged owning-tool asOf 2026-07-31T13:30:00.000Z (EWS score 83.5 -> 83.7 with fxStrength +0.09 -> +0.25 still FX neutral; EWA 64.7 -> 66.4; EWC 66.1 -> 66.3) - a same-bar re-quote of a carried read, not a bar advance. Everything structural stays byte-frozen: VIX 15.99 (band 'VIX 16.0', score 0), SPY 747.03 (ma50Dist +0.38%, ma200Dist +7.12%, -1.4% from the 52w high, mom126 +8.21%, mom252 +19.05%), the sector RRG (XLY into quad I accel +0.9, XLE out quad L, XLV leader quad W), the gamma/structure levels (flip 740.09, walls 741/749, EM ±4.27, signedNetGEX +2.199B), heatmap breadth 48.64% narrow, volatility-sizing forecast 13.9101% throttle ×1.08, and the JMOM-led 6M ETF ranking. Signature: across >=3 same-bar windows, off-hours re-quotes can drift in EITHER direction on multiple legs while completed-bar-anchored coverage and every persistence counter stay pinned.
items.method: Extend the 'intra-bar window progression' detector with an 'off-hours bidirectional oscillation' test that fires when a NEWER snapshot advances the window WITHOUT advancing the completed-bar frontier AND >=1 off-hours-dated leg changes value in a DIRECTION OPPOSITE to its change in the prior same-bar window. Trigger on FIVE tests: (1) WINDOW ADVANCES BUT BAR DOES NOT = snapshot.window changes (here morning -> pre-close) while dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is UNCHANGED versus the prior window (still 2026-07-31) with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (287/287, 0, 0) - a same-bar re-price, NOT an append; (2) COVERAGE HELD FLAT = richCount/coverageCount unchanged (12/10) and no tool flips STALE<->ANALYZED versus the prior window; (3) STRUCTURAL LEVELS UNCHANGED = regime + bench are byte-identical (VIX 15.99 / band 'VIX 16.0' / score 0; SPY 747.03 / +0.38% / +7.12% / +8.21% / +19.05%) and the sector RRG metrics are identical (XLY into, XLE out, XLV leader); (4) OFF-HOURS LEGS MAY DRIFT EITHER WAY = compare each off-hours-dated leg (crypto BTC-USD on its daily stamp; carried global-rotation board) to its prior-window value and record the sign of the change - here BTC-USD flips from easing (-) to firming (+) 30.9 -> 31.3 and the global-rotation board firms (+) EWS 83.5 -> 83.7 - a REVERSAL relative to the prior easing window; (5) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, an identical read keeps its prior distinct-bar count (XLY stays early-persistent across [07-30, 07-31] = 2; the structural tools stay at 1 = [07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - repeated intraday runs (pre-market -> morning -> pre-close) on the SAME 07-31 bar do NOT increment the counter, and an off-hours re-priced leg wandering in EITHER direction (BTC-USD 30.9 -> 31.3 on its unchanged 08-02 stamp; global-rotation EWS 83.5 -> 83.7 on its unchanged 07-31 owning-tool asOf) is NOT a completed-equity-bar advance and never moves persistence.

bars.note: The completed 07-31 daily session was appended in the pre-market window; the morning and this pre-close window both re-price the SAME 07-31 bar without advancing the frontier (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing).

into.reasonNotIncremented: Same completed 07-31 bar as the prior morning window; a repeated intraday run (morning -> pre-close, third same-bar window) does not add a distinct completed bar date.

loneMoverReversed.note: Crypto daily-dated leg holds its 08-02 stamp but its score REVERSES this window, firming 30.9 -> 31.3 after three easing windows (31.4 -> 31.1 -> 30.9); an off-hours quote change on the completed 07-31 equity bar, not itself a bar advance, so it does not increment persistence.

secondDriftingLeg.note: The carried global-rotation board firmed modestly on its UNCHANGED owning-tool asOf 2026-07-31T13:30:00.000Z - a same-bar off-hours re-quote of a carried read, not a completed-bar advance; does not increment persistence.
